# GeoMachine Developer Group
> High-performance web development, mobile apps, local private AI servers, SEO, and cloud maintenance. Direct senior engineer contact, closed fixed pricing, fast delivery.

## About GeoMachine Developer Group
GeoMachine Developer Group is a European software engineering studio specializing in high-performance web applications, mobile applications (iOS/Android), custom local private AI servers, SEO optimization, and managed cloud VPS infrastructure.

- Website: https://geomachine.es
- Languages Supported: Spanish (es), Russian (ru), English (en), Georgian (ka)
- Business Model: Fixed closed pricing, zero sales intermediaries, direct engineer communication, delivery in days instead of months.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Web Development & High-Performance Landings
- Frameworks & Tech: Astro, Next.js, React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Vanilla CSS.
- Features: 100/100 Google Lighthouse Core Web Vitals, dark obsidian neumorphic aesthetics, 3D tilt cards, instant multi-currency pricing (€, ₽, ₾).
- Primary URL: https://geomachine.es/es/servicios/#landings

### 2. Full-Stack Web Applications & E-Commerce
- Full-stack web apps, custom stores, SaaS platforms, dashboard panels, REST/GraphQL APIs.
- Primary URL: https://geomachine.es/es/servicios/#fullstack

### 3. Native & Cross-Platform Mobile Applications
- iOS and Android apps built with Flutter, React Native, and Swift.
- App Store & Google Play publishing setup, offline sync, push notifications.
- Primary URL: https://geomachine.es/es/servicios/#mobile

### 4. Custom Private AI Servers & LLM Integration
- Local LLM deployment (DeepSeek, Llama 3, Mistral) on private VPS/GPU servers.
- Custom RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, autonomous WhatsApp/Telegram AI bots.
- 100% data privacy and compliance without third-party API dependencies.
- Primary URL: https://geomachine.es/es/servicios/#ai

### 5. Managed VPS Infrastructure & Cloud Maintenance
- Nginx, Docker, SSL certificates, automated backups, 99.9% uptime monitoring, server security hardening.
- Primary URL: https://geomachine.es/es/servicios/#mnt

### 6. International & Multilingual SEO
- On-page SEO, hreflang multi-locale setup, structured JSON-LD schema, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini).
- Primary URL: https://geomachine.es/es/servicios/#seo
